name: @pond-ts/fit
description: Fitness & activity domain library on pond-ts: typed quantities, canonical activity series, and analytics (geo distance/elevation, power NP/IF/TSS, zones, splits)

scripts.prepack: cp ../../LICENSE ./LICENSE && cp ../../CHANGELOG.md ./CHANGELOG.md && cp ../../API.md ./API.md && cp ../../docs/agents/USING_POND.md ./AGENTS.md && npm run build && cp cjs-fallback.cjs dist/cjs-fallback.cjs && find dist -name '*.map' -delete
scripts.test: npm run test:type && npm run test:runtime
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run build && npm test
